summary: Полный архитектурный аудит main выявил два major-дефекта жизненного цикла производных артефактов и пять minor-рисков точности, масштабируемости и границ модулей. Главные проблемы: stale testing context из удалённых worktree и не обновляемые accepted wiki snapshots.

acceptance.criterion: Проверены архитектурные сильные стороны, риски и конкретные дефекты полного текущего проекта
acceptance.evidence: architecture.md: разделы «Сильные стороны», «Findings», «Границы модулей и связность»

acceptance.criterion: Проверены границы модулей, lifecycle consistency, schema enforcement и scalability
acceptance.evidence: ARCH-001, ARCH-003, ARCH-004, ARCH-005, ARCH-006 и раздел «Жизненный цикл и схемы»

acceptance.criterion: Оценена измеримая польза graph/wiki/keryx и stale-context failure modes
acceptance.evidence: architecture.md: раздел «Насколько graph/wiki/keryx помогают по сравнению с обычным поиском»; cycle precision 1/10, stale wiki counters и paired benchmark

artifacts.summary: Ограничение на проверку текущего поведения через source CLI

findings.problem: Testing context recursively indexes nested worktrees and accepts its cache without input freshness or existence validation.
findings.impact: Related/scoped test selection can return or execute deleted tests from another branch, invalidating verification of the current checkout.
findings.suggested_fix: Exclude nested worktrees in a shared walker, persist an input fingerprint, rebuild stale context, and filter nonexistent cached paths.
findings.evidence: src/testing/service.ts:23, src/testing/service.ts:319, src/testing/service.ts:388, src/testing/service.ts:620, src/testing/selection.ts:19; 1041/1570 cached tests belong to two deleted .worktrees.

class_scope.enumeration_method: Used gdgraph to locate the testing subsystem, keryx ctx rg to enumerate TestingContext load/selection sites, then inspected both naming and import-based lookup and counted every cached .worktrees path.

findings.problem: gdgraph classifies fallback type-only imports as unknown-static and includes them in a query presented as runtime/load-order cycles.
findings.impact: Nine of ten reported SCCs are not established runtime cycles, creating false architectural findings and unnecessary refactoring.
findings.suggested_fix: Add type-only ImportKind, parse import/export type in fallback, and separate runtime, type and unknown cycle output.
findings.evidence: src/gdgraph/build.ts:239,262; src/gdgraph/types.ts:25; src/gdgraph/query.ts:108; 9/10 SCC contain unknown-static edges, including explicit import type statements.

findings.problem: Accepted generated wiki snapshots are skipped by collection while Describes:none excludes them from code freshness checks.
findings.impact: Authoritative-looking accepted maps can remain materially stale without warning; project-map reports 685 nodes/1502 edges/0 unresolved versus 1172/3515/50 now.
findings.suggested_fix: Separate machine-owned snapshot blocks from prose, track producer revision/hash, refresh snapshots regardless editorial status, and report producer-stale.

class_scope.enumeration_method: Used keryx ctx rg to enumerate every Describes:none page (four total), classified the three generated snapshot maps versus the decision page, and traced generation, accepted-page skip policy and freshness classification.

findings.problem: Wiki freshness performs per-page Git queries in a sequential loop.
findings.impact: Freshness cost grows linearly through process spawning; current 50-page run already performs 96 Git calls and takes about 1.05 seconds.
findings.suggested_fix: Batch pages by verified revision, compute changed paths once per revision, cache ancestry/existence, and bound concurrency for remaining checks.
findings.evidence: src/wiki/freshness/report.ts:174; src/wiki/freshness/page-freshness.ts:65; instrumented source run: 96 Git calls for 50 pages.

findings.problem: src/lib is documented as the bottom layer but owns serve/narrate/template orchestration with 20 upward cross-module production edges.
findings.impact: The namespace no longer communicates dependency direction and increases future cycle/extraction cost.
findings.suggested_fix: Move orchestration to feature owners, keep lib inward-only, and enforce allowed dependency directions with an architecture test.
findings.evidence: docs/docs/architecture.md; src/lib/serve-turn.ts:22; graph shows 14 lib-to-harness edges and 20 upward edges total.

findings.problem: Init and update duplicate lifecycle helpers and already differ in parent-directory preparation.
findings.impact: Fixes to installation atomicity, permissions or hook reconciliation can apply to only one lifecycle path.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract shared reconcile/install primitives and cover init/update with common table-driven contract tests.
findings.evidence: src/commands/init.ts:1373,1821; src/commands/update.ts:1325,1558; six overlapping helper names.

findings.problem: Wiki collect/provenance/describes form a genuine static dependency cycle.
findings.impact: Future top-level initialization or isolated reuse can become load-order fragile; parser-level code depends back on orchestration.
findings.suggested_fix: Move shared types/key-file inference to a leaf module and remove the describes-to-collect dependency.
findings.evidence: src/wiki/collect.ts:5 -> src/wiki/provenance.ts:23 -> src/wiki/describes.ts:26 -> src/wiki/collect.ts; SCC has no unknown-static edges.
